name: Roberto Gonzalez Barrera
current_role: Deceased (died 25 Aug 2012, Houston, Texas); was chairman of Gruma and lifetime honorary chairman of Grupo Financiero Banorte
notes: Died 25 August 2012 aged 81. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roberto_Gonz%C3%A1lez_Barrera ; https://expansion.mx/negocios/2012/08/25/fallece-roberto-gonzalez-barrera . Son Juan Antonio Gonzalez Moreno now leads Gruma.

name: Mario Brescia Cafferata
current_role: Deceased (died 16 May 2013, Lima); was co-chairman of Grupo Breca and chairman of BBVA Continental
notes: Died May 2013. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mario_Brescia_Cafferata ; https://www.mch.cl/fallece-empresario-peruano-mario-brescia-presidente-del-holding-breca-dueno-de-cemento-melon-y-pinturas-tricolor/ . Grupo Breca is now run by the next generation of the Brescia family.
